name: Akechi Mitsuhide
source:
"Every loss will take you away."

Akechi Mitsuhide, a courtly warrior in the service of Nobunaga. A man who is sincere and too kind to everyone. What are the hidden thoughts in his heart?

Temperament: Sincere and serious.
Likes: Okaka onigiri
